description: Réseaux - Point de couverture wifi - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.grandpoitiers.fr. Positioning of the public wifi terminals of the PublicWifiPoitiers de Grand Poitiers service. It is updated as the terminals are installed and shut down. The first publication corresponds to the commissioning of a coherent first batch of terminals. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Networks — Wi-Fi cover point — Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include borne, réseau, données ouvertes, hotspot, publicwifipoitiers, Internet. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
